entities.summary: Avisa Relation oder Zeitung was one of the first news-periodicals in the world. It was published in Wolfenbüttel, Germany, in 1609. The printer/publisher was Julius Adolph von Söhne. The first issue states that the news had been collected from various countries by 15 January. It is presumed that the issue was printed on or about that date.
